goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The text-first phase is approved: fresh runtime evidence proves a real local web workflow, persistent canonical state, reviewed memories, changed-source invalidation and cited search without weakening legacy gates. It is not the full product. The next largest safe package is real PDF/DOCX extraction through the same ingest/review/search interfaces. It must preserve exact binary snapshots, produce page/section locators, expose readable/openable citations, reject malformed/encrypted/oversized files, pin Node 18-compatible parsers, disable external DOCX file access, and install dependencies reproducibly in CI.

worker_package.objective: Add production-shaped PDF and DOCX support to the local web workflow: browser binary ingestion, exact immutable snapshots, PDF page extraction, DOCX semantic section extraction, page/section-located candidates, openable extracted and raw source citations, malformed/encrypted/oversized error handling, deterministic warnings, pinned Node 18/22-compatible dependencies, reproducible lockfile/CI installation, and regression coverage using real generated binary documents. Remove the deferred labels only when the runtime tests pass.
stop_if: Implementation requires a parser that does not support Node.js 18 and 22.
A parser needs external network, external file access, macros, or executable document content.
PDF/DOCX bytes cannot remain bounded and local-only.
Citation locators cannot identify a PDF page or DOCX section.
Implementation requires changes outside the explicit allowed_files.
Existing text ingestion, canonical-vault persistence, review, search, or legacy release gates regress.

evidence: Browser walkthrough: import -> review -> approve -> search -> cited source
PDF.js official Node extraction API via pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs
Mammoth official Buffer conversion API with external file access disabled

parallel_safety.reason: Binary extraction changes the shared ingest, locator, source-viewer, UI, dependency and CI contracts.

missing_evidence: Hindsight projection and recall from approved web memories remain unimplemented.
Folder deletion reconciliation and governed canonical deletion remain unimplemented.
Packaged non-terminal launch and clean-install walkthrough remain unimplemented.
required_board_updates: Create and activate T005 from worker_package.
After T005, continue directly to a governed Hindsight web-projection package unless binary parser risk requires review.
